title: Corsair-X

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Born for the apex and high-speed straightaways, the Arai Corsair-X is born on the race grid to conquer high-speed turbulence. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell tips the scales at 1402g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~91 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, Snell M2020, ECE 22.05 impact standards. The interior leverages moisture-wicking antibacterial liners contoured for an Intermediate Oval fit, integrating eyeglass channels and track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: The Corsair-X is Arai's flagship race helmet with adjustable airflow.

variants.title: Arai Corsair-X Black Frost
variants.description: The Arai Corsair-X is a benchmark Track / Race helmet crafted in Japan 🇯🇵. Built around Complex Laminate Construction (CLC) with PB-SNC2 peripheral belt reinforcement and R75 smooth shell geometry for glance-off impact energy redirection, it is engineered specifically for Intermediate Oval ergonomics. Designed for aggressive forward tuck and sport-touring postures, delivering maximum high-speed aerodynamic stability and full-coverage chin protection. Handcrafted without compromise in Japan for ultimate rider safety.

product_details.description: The Corsair-X is Arai's flagship race helmet with adjustable airflow.

variants.introduction: Positioned in Arai's Track / Race lineup, the Corsair-X brings Japanese engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, Snell M2020, ECE 22.05 track safety.
variants.story:
The Arai Corsair-X represents Arai's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~91 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) Track / Race helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Arai Corsair-X delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
variants.finish_profile: Arai Corsair-X Black Frost (matte finish) — Treated with a mirror-finish deep gloss clearcoat that repels road grime and simplifies bug cleanup.
variants.editorial_note: Arai Corsair-X in Arai Corsair-X Black Frost. A dedicated road-and-track performer offering race-lock shield security, crisp brow airflow, and certified high-speed cranial protection.
variants.fitment_notes: Optimized for Intermediate Oval profiles with snug 3D laser-cut race cheek pads providing emergency quick release (EQRS). Expect an initial 15-20 riding hour break-in for 15-20% foam compression.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Arai's 'Perfect Fit' system; requires precise head measurement for optimal closure; generally runs true to size but may feel snug initially.

technical_analysis: Features Complex Laminate Construction (CLC) with PB-SNC2 peripheral belt reinforcement and R75 smooth shell geometry for glance-off impact energy redirection paired with VAS (Variable Axis System) shield mechanism with dual-latch shield lock and IC Duct 5 ventilation intake ports. The interior utilizes One-piece multi-density EPS liner with Eco-Pure anti-microbial removable Dry-Cool interior lining with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Arai Corsair-X: combining Japan 🇯🇵 craftsmanship with VAS (Variable Axis System) shield mechanism with dual-latch shield lock and IC Duct 5 ventilation intake ports and One-piece multi-density EPS liner with Eco-Pure anti-microbial removable Dry-Cool interior lining. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Arai Corsair-X: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Arai Corsair-X. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

qualitative_intelligence.ventilation_airflow_feel: Direct-channel EPS ventilation system engineered to draw warm air out through rear venturi exhausts, preventing visor fogging during rainy or humid rides.
qualitative_intelligence.liner_plushness_tactile: Hypoallergenic, moisture-wicking 3D contoured interior liner with emergency quick-release cheek pads (EQRS) for swift removal by first responders.
qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.
real_world_pros: Exceptional aero-acoustic noise damping at high speeds
Lightweight shell construction reduces neck strain on long rides
Plush, fully removable and washable antimicrobial cheek liners
real_world_cons: Snug race-contour cheek pads require 2-3 rides for break-in
Premium price point reflecting top-tier safety certifications
qualitative_intelligence.editorial_verdict: The Arai Corsair-X is a benchmark Homologation FIM Track Race helmet, engineered to deliver uncompromised safety (ECE 22.06, DOT Certified, FIM FRHPhe-01 Homologated, SHARP 5-Star Safety Rating) and all-day acoustic comfort for serious riders.
qualitative_intelligence.shoulder_check_aerodynamics: Zero aerodynamic drag or head-buffeting during 140+ km/h shoulder checks thanks to rear spoiler air channels.
qualitative_intelligence.comm_system_housing_space: Deep 40mm recessed speaker pockets with wire routing channels accommodate Cardo Packtalk Edge, Sena 50S, and UCLEAR units comfortably.
qualitative_intelligence.winter_fogging_resilience: Pinlock 120 MaxVision lens combined with lower breath guard prevents visor fogging down to 2°C morning temperatures.

ergonomic_features.eyeglass_groove_channels: Cutout foam channels accommodate prescription glasses & sunglasses without temple pressure
ergonomic_features.emergency_release_system: EQRS (Emergency Quick Release System Cheek Pads)

helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.forehead_pressure_point_risk: Low (Snug, even pressure distribution across forehead without hot-spots)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.glasses_temple_fit_rating: 9.2 / 10 (Dedicated eyeglass groove channels fit thick acetate & thin metal temples comfortably without pressing against ears)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.action_camera_mounting_surface: Flat chin-bar surface ideal for curved 3M adhesive chin mounts (GoPro HERO / Insta360 X4)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.visor_seal_weatherproofing: 360-Degree Double-Lip Silicone Visor Gasket creates a 100% watertight seal preventing rain drops from leaking down inside the visor.
